title: It's pouring
setting: They were going to meet outside. It starts pouring, and they have to pick an indoor place on the phone while walking.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Hey—can you hear me? It's pouring over here.
lines.spoken: Hey—can you hear me? It's pouring over here.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Yeah, it just started on my side too. I don't even have a jacket.
lines.spoken: Yeah, it just started on my side too. I don't even have a jacket.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Me neither. This is so stupid. You wanna just meet inside?
lines.spoken: Me neither. This is so stupid. You wanna just meet inside?

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Where, though? I'm like two blocks from the coffee place on Third.
lines.spoken: Where, though? I'm like two blocks from the coffee place on Third.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: The one next to the bookstore?
lines.spoken: The one next to the bookstore?

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Yeah. I can be there in five. I don't wanna stand out here.
lines.spoken: Yeah. I can be there in five. I don't wanna stand out here.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Same. I'm closer to the other one, but... whatever, I'll walk to Third.
lines.spoken: Same. I'm closer to the other one, but... whatever, I'll walk to Third.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: You sure? I can come to you.
lines.spoken: You sure? I can come to you.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: No, you're already wet, I'm already wet. Let's just pick one. Third is fine.
lines.spoken: No, you're already wet, I'm already wet. Let's just pick one. Third is fine.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Okay. I'll grab a table if I get there first.
lines.spoken: Okay. I'll grab a table if I get there first.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: If they have a table. It's gonna be packed, it's raining.
lines.spoken: If they have a table. It's gonna be packed, it's raining.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Then I'll just... hover by the door like a normal person.
lines.spoken: Then I'll just... hover by the door like a normal person.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Romantic. Okay, I'm walking. Don't wait outside.
lines.spoken: Romantic. Okay, I'm walking. Don't wait outside.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: I won't. See you in a bit.
lines.spoken: I won't. See you in a bit.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: See you. If I look like a drowned cat, don't say anything.
lines.spoken: See you. If I look like a drowned cat, don't say anything.

accept: the one next to the bookstore

roleplay.setupZh: 你们本来要在外面碰面，突然下起大雨。两个人都没带外套。你要提议改到室内，并尽快敲定一家店，不要来回推让。
roleplay.aiRole: Chris, already close to a coffee place on Third, wet and easygoing. He can come to you, but he'd rather you just pick one place quickly.
variants: The Third Street place looks closed from Chris's side.
Maya is much closer to the other cafe.
They can't hear each other well in the rain.
mustUse: I don't wanna stand out here

fluency.promptZh: 讲讲这场雨怎么打乱计划：他们本来要在哪见，为什么改地方，最后选了哪家，谁先到。准备 15 秒，然后 60、45、30 秒。
fluency.promptEn: Tell how the rain changed the plan: where they were meeting, why they moved, which place they picked, and who would arrive first. Prep 15 seconds, then 60, 45, 30.
